599:t_015:19.en:
$$リディ$$
「But $c was different... I'm sure that here, I can believe in the future again, too...」

599:t_015:20.en:
$$リディ$$
「Even if what awaits beyond it is a mighty power beyond human understanding...」

599:t_016:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「...A promise of $$ニュータイプ$$ participation in the $$連邦政府$$... That is what $$ラプラスの箱$$ really is...」

599:t_016:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「So it was as $$フロンタル$$ surmised after all.」

599:t_016:2.en:
$$オットー$$
「Just that... That's all it was...」

599:t_016:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$サイアム・ビスト$$ was a shrewd man. He threatened the government with the existence of the monument, but never made unreasonable demands.」

599:t_016:4.en:
$$リディ$$
「He contributed to the growth of $$アナハイム・エレクトロニクス$$, then a rising company, and built up the $$ビスト財団$$...」

599:t_016:5.en:
$$オットー$$
「And so a symbiotic relationship with the Federation began...」

599:t_016:6.en:
$$オットー$$
「The original monument... A system maintained by keeping $$ラプラスの箱$$ reverently hidden away...」

599:t_016:7.en:
$$オットー$$
「It no longer matters what's inside. A box that symbolizes the order of the world, then.」

599:t_016:8.en:
$$リディ$$
「At first, it was no more than a scandal that could threaten the government of the day.」

599:t_016:9.en:
$$リディ$$
「But the rise of the $$ジオン公国$$ changed everything.」

599:t_016:10.en:
$$リディ$$
「Whether $$ニュータイプ$$s actually exist is not the issue. The very fact that the Federation buried that clause becomes the greatest weapon for those who revere $$ジオン$$.」

599:t_016:11.en:
$$リディ$$
「That is why the existence of the Box had to be kept secret. To keep this world from turning into hell.」

599:t_016:12.en:
$$リディ$$
「But in the end, hell came anyway. A hell called the $$一年戦争$$.」

599:t_016:13.en:
$$リディ$$
「The scale of that sacrifice, and the existence of $$ニュータイプ$$s proven by the war, made the curse of the Box even heavier.」

599:t_016:14.en:
$$リディ$$
「That is why my old man and the others... $$クロノ$$, who would not allow the Spacenoids to exist, had to keep the secret.」

599:t_016:15.en:
$$リディ$$
「To deny them hope... a future, they maintained a warped system and chose a path where people are gradually tamed.」

599:t_016:16.en:
$$リディ$$
「And that is what kills possibility...」

599:t_016:17.en:
$$リディ$$
「But what is this order that was protected that way...?」

599:t_016:18.en:
$$リディ$$
「I definitely heard her... I heard $$マリーダ$$'s voice...!」

599:t_016:20.en:
$$リディ$$
「People can understand each other... There's that kind of possibility in people, too...」

599:t_016:21.en:
$$リディ$$
「I said I'd protect them, but I never believed in the people I was protecting. I let everyone down and lost everything...」

599:t_017:0.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「Those purple ones! $$フロンタル$$'s personal guard!?」

599:t_017:1.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「The Colonel has given us permission! All units, fire on $$メガラニカ$$!」

599:t_018:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「So you've come out, $$ユニコーン$$!」

599:t_018:1.en:
$$ネオ・ジオン兵$$
「Captain! There's no pilot aboard that $$ガンダム$$!」

599:t_018:2.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「So our earlier attack swept it out of the dock.」

599:t_018:3.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Perfect! I'll destroy it before that cocky brat climbs aboard!!」

599:t_021:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$ユニコーン$$... You answered my cry, didn't you.」

599:t_021:2.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Monster! But I have a way to contain you!」

599:t_022:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「What is this!? The $$サイコミュ$$ is being cut off!」

599:t_022:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「The $$サイコジャマー$$! So it was finished!」

599:t_022:3.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「That's a system that cancels out the psychic waves controlling the $$サイコミュ$$ by hitting them with stronger waves!」

599:t_022:4.en:
$$クェス$$
「With that, $$ユニコーン$$ can't bring out its power!」

599:t_022:5.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「$$バナージ・リンクス$$! I've hated you since the day we first met!」

599:t_022:6.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Just die already, you bastard!!」

599:t_022:7.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I won't lose to such one-sided malice!」

599:t_022:8.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「What!? His psychic waves are exceeding our projected values!」

599:t_022:10.en:
$$シャア$$
「He's different from how he's been until now!」

599:t_022:11.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「This is... $$バナージ$$'s light!」

599:t_022:12.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$オードリー$$ is waiting for me! So that we can carve out a future together!」

599:t_022:13.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$ガンダム$$! If you're the machine that guides the future, turn my feelings into power!!」

599:t_023:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Did $$ユニコーン$$'s psycho-field break through the system!?」

599:t_023:2.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Go, $$リディ$$! You're the one to back up $$バナージ$$!」

599:t_023:4.en:

「Please go! So that $$マリーダ$$'s feelings won't be in vain!」

599:t_026:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「I'll atone for it in time...! But right now!」

599:t_026:3.en:
